# Life Extension

> > Life Extension is a science-based wellness company offering premium vitamins, supplements, and longevity products designed to support optimal health and healthy aging.

Life Extension provides a comprehensive catalog of evidence-based nutritional supplements across multiple health categories, from foundational multivitamins to specialized formulations for cognitive health, cardiovascular support, and longevity. The company emphasizes scientific research and quality ingredients in its product offerings.

## Key Topics

- CoQ10
- NAD+ Cell Regenerator
- Vitamin D3

- MacuGuard Ocular Support
- FLORASSIST Probiotic
- Super Omega-3 EPA/DHA
- Anti-aging supplements
- Cognitive health

- Energy supplements
- Probiotics

- Longevity
